note: Export side is factually confirmed: three dated outbound customs lines (16/22/28 Feb 2026) from Dighi ICD to the UK with BOL numbers, all HS 84842000 (mechanical seals / seal spares) — note the declared HS 848410 (gaskets of metal sheeting) does not match the observed 84842000; per project rules this is not a rejection ground, the code should be corrected to the factual 84842000. Caveat on the counter: ImportKey's 2537 figure aggregates both directions and all counterparties (the same page lists AESSEAL PLC as supplier with 5704 shipments and shows inbound lines such as "2026-02-23 AESSEAL PLC -> AESSEAL INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED ... 84139190 BOL 7696214"), so 2537 is not a pure export count; only 5 rows were actually seen. The trade is largely intra-group (import of components from AESSEAL PLC, export of finished seals back), which is normal for an MNC subsidiary. Domestic Indian supply (GST turnover, public tenders) remains unverified — no evidence found, not a negative finding.
